notes.title: Who Did It? Update 1.4 "The International Investigation Update" Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Detectives![/p][p]Finally, welcome to update 1.4! This update was supposed to be released back in April, but it took a bit more time. But it was worth the wait! Watch the trailer for a quick overview or keep reading for all the details![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Scws6gpv_9E;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Highlights:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Localization[/h3][p]Who Did It? It is now available in the following languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch & German! All UI elements as well as in-game content and case data have all been carefully translated to these languages! You can easily change between them at any time from the options menu![/p][p][b]What about Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean?[/b][/p][p]Previously mentioned on the roadmap. These three languages were planned to be added as well, but we encountered a few challenges to make it work. For now, we have decided not to implement these languages at this time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Introducing: Perfect Cases[/h3][p]All cases have had a small change to the completion of each one. As well as completing the case, you will now also need to complete the case without using hints or without using strikes. You can keep track of this via the case selection screen. If you have completed these 3 objectives, you will have a “perfect case” and it will reflect a gold border around the case card in the case selector. (You don't have to have perfect cases to continue/finish the game)[/p][p][/p][h3]Detective's Notes[/h3][p]Ever wanted to take some notes during your case solving? Say no more! You can now open a notepad while on a case! See the icon on the top right of your screen and the menu will open. [/p][p][i][b]Please note that these notes will be deleted when you solve, restart or leave a case.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Faster loading screens & General optimizations[/h3][p]Loading into cases will now take up less time. We've also implemented a few UI optimizations, especially for 1080p users. This will mark the start of our process to eventually support 720p as well.[/p][p][/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][p][/p][p]NEW[/p][list][*][p]Added localization for French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch & German.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting for language to the options screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Perfect Cases” system.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new icons for “Perfect Cases” system.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Detective's notes panel to the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]CHANGES[/p][list][*][p]Overhauled the options menu with new icons and layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the position of the “update available” popup to the top left to prevent it from overlapping with other UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the loading time of loading screens[/p][/*][*][p]Removed loading screen tips[/p][/*][*][p]Improved scaling for 1080p resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p]FIXES[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Supporter Edition's logo on the main menu. It should now properly show the correct logo when you have bought the supporter DLC.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the case info card placement on the pregame screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]FEEDBACK[/b] [/p][p]Got feedback, suggestions or did you find bugs? [url="https://whodiditgame.com/feedback"]Please fill in this feedback form[/url]   [/p][p][/p][p][i]Note: It can take up to a few hours for the update to show up. You could try restarting your Steam client to check for updates![/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]The Detective's notes panel is stuck in English translations, even when another language is selected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for now![/p][p][/p][p][b]Sem (a.k.a. @beldrnl)[/b][/p][p][i]Who Did It? Developer[/i][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.4 Sneak Peek - Who Did It? Devlog #5
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives

The next big update for Who Did It? It is getting closer and closer to its release date. Firstly, I'm sorry for the big delay. Turns out that translating the entire game in multiple languages was a bit more difficult than first anticipated.

The update is not ready just yet, but here is a small sneak peek of what's to come.

[h2]”3-Star System"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281074/d824e3e63a4cab1865e91b77c446f508cc941e5e.png[/img]

This UI is not final, but this is the general idea. These are not literally stars, but these new icons will add an extra layer of replayability and progress overview for those completionists!

You don't need to complete all three objectives to continue the game, these are here as an extra challenge. If you want to “fully” close a case or complete it perfectly, you'll need to do so without using hints or strikes. (Note that this is not based on difficulty at this moment)

[h2]Game Translations[/h2]

Currently, the game is translated to Dutch, French, German, Italian & Spanish. You'll be able to quickly switch between these languages via the options menu.

[h2]More features in the works[/h2]

As I said, the update is not finished. But this is what I can share at this time. Please let me know what you think of it and also send me your suggestions on how we can implement the “3 star” system even better.

As always, you can post your suggestions in the comments or use the [url=https://whodiditgame.com/feedback]Who Did It? Feedback Form[/url]

That's it for now!

Sem (a.k.a. @beldrnl)
Who Did It? Developer

notes.title: Who Did It? Update 1.3 "The Rank and Role Update" Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives!

It has been a really long time since the last update. But this update will completely change the game for good! You can watch the video trailer for the big highlights or read the full patch notes below.

[previewyoutube=o5wvoF4Rz0A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Level & ID Card System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281074/6dd1c07eccb0eecf365f1076842409054fb68cbc.png[/img]

Introducing a full level and ID-Card system. There are about 9 ID Cards to collect at this moment, but more will come later.

[b]How does this work?[/b]
Each case you close earns you XP depending on your selected game mode, difficulty and performance. When you have enough XP, you will automatically get a higher tier ID-Card!

You can change your currently selected ID Card via the settings menu.

[b]New XP Summary[/b]
To show how you got your XP, a new XP Summary screen has been implemented at the end of a case.

[b]Special Insane Challenge Rewards[/b]
When you complete the Insane Challenge you will unlock a special ID Card design, and you will receive a big XP bonus of 400 XP (per case completed)

[b]New achievements[/b]
There are 3 new "level" related achievements to collect. You get the new achievements by reaching level 30, 50 and 100. 100 Is currently the max level!

[b]Case High scores[/b]
Improve your own high scores with the new high scores system. Each case you complete earns you XP, and that XP is also your score. So, by doing a better job on the case or playing at a higher difficulty allows you to improve your high score!

[b]Better Genders[/b]
The dropdown when selecting a suspect has been improved and now has a subtle blue or pink background to show if the suspect is a man or woman. This is to resolve some confusing clues regarding genders.

[h2]New Case Briefing[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281074/4a4bc4e8fde0e38ddcb7994ca325f9ea4b63135c.png[/img]

The difficulty and game mode selection screens have been completely overhauled and are now combined into one easy to use screen.

There was a lot of feedback regarding not being able to change your selection after choosing and the overall confusing UI, so it got completely reworked! 

[i]Hint: You can read a small teaser on the new briefing screen regarding the next update![/i]

[h2]Main Menu Sidebar[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281074/80a4db4142313cd9be2fea7632171518ce373a3c.png[/img]

The Main Menu has had a makeover. There is now a new sidebar with your ID Card and level, The current update patch notes and a better placed feedback button.



These were the big headlines. Below is a full changelog.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]

[h3]NEW[/h3]
- Added Level and ID Card system.
- Added new XP Summary to the end-case overview.
- Added Player taglines (updated when story progresses).
- Added new main menu sidebar.
- Added ID Card change screen.
- Added High scores to case selection screen.
- Added "Noob" achievement (complete a case with the easiest game mode and difficulty).
- Added 3 level related achievements.


[h3]CHANGES[/h3]
- Overhauled difficulty and game mode selection into one case briefing.
- Changed the background of the dropdown to better suit the suspect's gender.
- Changed the description of the ??? Achievement to make it easier to get (added a hint).
- Changed the hints system behavior to not allow players to use more hints than the case has. The case summary now also shows the max hints.
- Changed the "Update available" banner text on the main menu to make it clear where to download the update.
- The red text color of the "last strike number" at the top of the screen is now the same color red as other red text in the game.
- Changed multiple input fields in the game to use the red accent color instead of blue to better match the game colors.


[h3]FIXES[/h3]
- Fixed placement of the loading screen "loading" icon.
- Fixed a rare issue where both the "continue" and "next level" buttons were visible at the end of the case.
- The end level overview placement has been fixed (for 1080p users).
- Fixed the sound settings sliders to show the currently selected value instead of "0%".
- Fixed the placement of the sound settings sliders to not shift the UI when changing the value.
- Fixed the "black screen" cutscene bug. Cutscenes now finish properly and go to the next screen at the end of the cutscene.
- Fixed a bug where some cutscenes were not available in the cutscene replay screen when you did watch them previously.
- Fixed a few menu transitions.
- Fixed a game breaking bug in the initialization process of the pre-game screen.


[b]FEEDBACK[/b]
Got feedback, suggestions or did you find bugs?
[url=https://whodiditgame.com/feedback]Please fill in this feedback form[/url]


[i]Note: It can take up to a few hours for the update to show up. You could try restarting your Steam client to check for updates![/i]

That was it for this time!

[b]Sem (a.k.a. @beldrnl)[/b]
[i]Who Did It? Developer[/i]

notes.title: Who Did It? Update 1.2 "Mystery Reimagined" Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives!

It has been some time since the last update, but this is a big one!

[previewyoutube=4qj_W2CH52w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Completely reworked story & new cutscenes[/h2]
After receiving much feedback from you. I felt like reworking the entire thing. I've kept the basics intact (no big character changes) but the rest is a completely new experience!

And the cutscenes are now replayable via the options menu

[h2]Gamemodes are here![/h2]
Gamemodes are extra modes beside the normal way the game works (the way you're used to is now called "Default"). Before starting each case you will select one of the two new gamemodes (more coming later) or the default gamemode and after that you choose your difficulty. You do this for each case.

The gamemodes are:
[list]
[*] Guess-Lock - After selecting a value in the dropdown, it becomes disabled, meaning you can't change your selection (hard)
[*] Crimeroom-only - A easier gamemode, you only need to get the crime room correct to close the case
[/list]

[i][b]It's recommended to play the entire game in the default gamemode at least once, It's the way the game originally was designed to be played![/b][/i]

[h2]Steam Cloud Support[/h2]
Finally, Who Did It? Has Steam Cloud support, meaning the game will syncronise your progress across your devices!

[h2]The Insane Challenge[/h2]
For the first time, Who Did It? Receives a special challenge only meant for the best detectives out there!
To complete this special challenge: Close any case in the new "Guess-Lock" gamemode with the Detective difficulty selected.

Upon completion of this challenge you will get a special achievement and a badge in-game which you can see in your statistics page.

[h2]New Steam Achievements[/h2]
Aside from the Insane Challenge, there are a number of new steam achievements added. Take a look at your achievements progress to find out!

notes.title: Who Did It? Update 1.1 "The Update Update"
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives,

Today is the day that the first [i]Who Did It?[/i] update launches!

This is not a huge update, but we've focused on the most important parts and added some highly requested features. Find the full changes below:

[h3]NEW in update 1.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Statistics screen; track your progress!*
[*] New Pause Menu! Press ESC in-game to open the menu; you can change your settings there, as well as pause the game. (Note: on the detective difficulty, the timer won't be paused!)
[*] New and improved settings screen. The previous settings screen has been updated, and the UI has improved.
[*] New suspect dropdown effect: See what dropdowns are still empty. You can turn this off in the settings.
[*] You can now skip cutscenes by pressing ESC.
[*] You can now also open a case from the "case overview" screen instead of having to scroll through all case files.
[*] Added the ability to skip the introduction tutorial at the start of the game (You can find this option in the ESC/Pause Menu)
[*] Added a global error handler to catch errors and to show a popup announcing the issue so you can report it to us. (backend)
[*] Added a popup to announce new updates.
[*] Added a new achievement: Complete any case in under one minute (not available in detective difficulty)
[/list]

[i]* The statistics will count from now. So progress from before this update is not visible on the statistics page, exept completed levels. (your save-data has not been touched, remains the same)[/i]

[h3]CHANGES in update 1.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game UI should now be better optimized for 1080p screens.
[*] Level-fail text is now dynamic, meaning if your time runs out, the text will say "Failed because you ran out of time" and something similar for the strikes.
[/list]

[h3]FIXES in update 1.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed many bugs regarding screen transitions and animations (especially the main menu)
[*] Fixed many spelling and grammar mistakes.
[/list]

That's it for this time. Please check out the update and let me know what you think!

Until next time,

[b]Sem (a.k.a. @beldrnl)[/b]
[i]Who Did It? Developer[/i]
